messages:
michael: Seeing widespread 503s for console and api in eu-west. Auth checks failing, sessions not validating. :rotating_light:
sara: on it, pulling control-plane pods in eu-west1 now
sara: `kubectl -n redwood-controlplane get pods` shows controller crashloops on envoy-proxy and api-server in eu-west1
sara: past hour's rollout? any config changes from yesterday night?
akshay: I see an automated config rollout completed 02:14 UTC for envoy routes. Could be related.
oncall-bot: alert: control-plane.europe cluster unhealthy (severity: high)
michael: rolling back that config sounds reasonable if rollout touched auth/routing
luke: pinged our CDN partner (edge-team) to see if we can do an emergency origin override to us-east for the console hostnames
jun: note: Dedicated autoscaler hitting control-plane API; if API is down nodes won't join - likely explains degraded capacity when shifting traffic
akshay: trying to fetch api logs from a control-plane pod; remote exec failing because apiserver not responding
akshay: logs snippet:
```
E0304 02:18:12.345678 1 server.go:200] failed to apply config: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
panic: failed to start router: invalid listener config
```

sara: ack - looks like the envoy cert rotation job produced a cert chain our apiserver doesn't trust
emma: got multiple CS tickets with login failures and 500s; customers calling in
deploy-bot: rollback request queued: config-rollout-2026-03-04-0214 (initiated by akshay)
akshay: deploy-bot will try to replay previous working config but note: rollout automation uses control-plane API to apply, might fail if apiserver is unhealthy
michael: can someone with console access apply a manual patch to remove the bad cert from the cluster secret? we have bastion still
jun: I can ssh to bastion and kubectl patch the secret via direct kubeconfig on the node that still has ETCD quorum
jun: doing: `kubectl --kubeconfig=/root/quorum-kubeconfig -n redwood-controlplane patch secret envoy-certs -p '{"data": {"tls.crt": ""}}'` (dry-run first)

luke: edge team can route ~30% traffic to us-east, but warn: us-east fleet currently at 75% GPU utilization; may hit degraded perf
akshay: trying to restore etcd snapshot from 02:10 (pre-rollout) as fallback, but etcd restore needs control-plane static pods restarted and might be disruptive
sara: short term plan: 1) edge override to route console to us-east, 2) manual patch to remove bad cert, 3) prevent further rollouts by disabling CI->control-plane webhook

michael: agreed. luke please start CDN override now. ping when done
luke: override started, `console.prod.redwood.ai` origin set to us-east-1-edge, TTL 30s. Monitoring traffic shift. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
akshay: attempted etcd restore but blocked; leader election failing because apiserver crashes on startup (cert error persists)
jun: I increased ASG desired in us-east from 6->9 to buy capacity headroom, manual scale complete

sara: removed rollout webhook in CI (disabled) and created temp block rule in deploy pipeline

deploy-bot: rollback status: failed -> apiserver refused connection, will retry once control-plane reachable

michael: ops note: because control-plane was down, autoscaler couldn't provision GPUs in eu-west. shifting traffic to us-east is the only viable path for now
emma: notified affected enterprise customers and updated status page with degraded console/API in EU, routing to US fallback

luke: traffic now ~32% to us-east. Error rate on eu origin dropping. us-east latency +10% and there's a small increase in 429s on heavy jobs (GPU throttling)
akshay: mitigation: temp route user-facing console to us-east and queue heavy batch jobs with backpressure. We should surface queueing policy to customers via status page
sara: manual fix applied: replaced envoy secret with previous cert bundle from vault, restarted control-plane pods one-by-one. apiserver came up for one replica at 02:58 UTC

michael: checking auth endpoints now... a handful of login attempts succeeding
akshay: full control-plane restored in eu-west at 03:05, but we have to verify config integrity before re-enabling rollouts
jun: autoscaler now able to talk to API, new nodes are joining; GPU pool recovering but still at 65% utilization after scale-up

deploy-bot: CI webhook re-enabled (disabled temporarily) by sara after manual approvals withheld

michael: status: console auth and routing largely restored for most customers. Edge override will remain for 30m while we validate. No data loss.

emma: created incident ticket INC-2026-03104 and assigned to eng-sre for postmortem and customer follow-up

michael: thank you all for fast work. action items: (1) postmortem with timeline + root cause (bad cert rotation) (2) add preflight check for cert chain validation to rollout job (3) autoscaler fallback path if control-plane unreachable (4) improve runbook for edge override

luke: noted, starting playbook PRs and will coordinate with platform eng for safer cert rotations :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: incident declared resolved -> degraded -> monitoring (update: 1760866100)
